input.rationale: No non-solicitation, no-hire or inducement covenant exists anywhere in the Agreement. § 14.8 Personnel — the expected home for such a restraint — addresses only each party's supervision, direction and control of its own personnel, IBM's right to assign its personnel, and IBM's right to subcontract to Subcontractors and Affiliates. Document-wide searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "employment", "engage", "induce", "recruit", "personnel" and "shall not" return no hiring or solicitation restraint; the only "shall not" restrictions on Bluefly are the no-resale covenant (§ 14.11) and interpretive/waiver provisions. This is the preferred position for this rule (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so the correct classification is "no covenant present" as compliant rather than missing, and no redline or counterparty comment is warranted. The deterministic sub-checks for a 12-month duration limit and a general-solicitation carve-out are vacuous here: there is no covenant whose duration or carve-outs could be measured, and their failure does not undercut compliance. Note for negotiation only: if IBM later proposes a non-solicit, we should hold to the fallback — mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of their involvement, with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches, and no no-hire.
